title: DisplayIdentity::author labels a record "you" when its session and actor id match but its actor kind differs
outcome: DisplayIdentity::author labels a record "you" when its session and actor id match but its actor kind differs
acceptance: A record whose session id and actor id equal the reader's but whose actor kind differs is not labelled "you"; a test covers it, and the existing same-session and peer labels are unchanged

completion.summary: A record whose session and actor id equal the reader's but whose actor kind differs is no longer labelled "you": author() also requires the agent kind the words and host channel record with, and the kind is carried through changes, history, notes, evaluator, status, record windows and next's note rows; other labels unchanged. Landed in b3fd3a2 (bundle 10 changeset 1).
